jobs.title: Maintenance Technician - Austin, TX
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As a Maintenance Technician, you ensure the community remains safe, functional, and well‑maintained by diagnosing and repairing a wide range of building and apartment systems. You provide timely, high‑quality service to residents, support preventative maintenance programs, and help preserve the property’s physical assets through consistent care and attention. Diagnose, repair, and resolve maintenance issues involving electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems, appliances, flooring, stairs, railings, and other building components. Correct unsafe conditions such as broken lights, damaged gates, open holes, or other hazards, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and safely. Support asset preservation by monitoring and reporting on the condition of building and security systems such as automatic doors and surveillance cameras. Schedule and perform preventative maintenance on HVAC units, equipment, and building systems to improve performance and reduce downtime. Maintain appropriate inventory of supplies and spare parts to ensure timely completion of work orders. Respond to on ‑ call rotations and emergency maintenance situations, assisting with both resident and property needs. Provide friendly, professional service when interacting with residents and team members. Document completed work and report recurring issues or safety concerns to your supervisor. Qualifications EPA certification required (Type I, II, or Universal). 1–3+ years of experience in maintenance, facilities

jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW: At Alo, our focus is on our associate culture, customer promise, quality, and safety. The Printer Technician supports print-on-demand (POD) production and fulfillment operations by troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining production printers, related equipment, and automated material handling systems. Working independently or with minimal guidance, this role helps maintain equipment reliability, print quality, and daily volume output while minimizing disruptions to production. The Printer Technician serves as an onsite technical resource, coordinates maintenance with Operations and Facilities, and applies an understanding of equipment performance, product flow, and production priorities to resolve issues safely and efficiently. Respond promptly to equipment issues that affect daily workflow or volume output; communicate downtime, repair status, and expected return to service to Operations and Facilities. Perform equipment audits, preventive maintenance, cleaning, adjustments, component replacement, and repairs according to manufacturer guidance and established safety and quality procedures. jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW: The Production / Wave Planning Manager is responsible for translating daily and weekly demand into an executable production plan for the distribution center. The Production / Wave Planning Manager leads the site Wave Planning team and maintains end-to-end visibility of work throughout the facility. The role proactively identifies constraints, adjusts release strategies, and coordinates with Operations, Labor Planning, WMS, Capacity Planning, and other partners to keep product flowing through the building. This is a highly analytical and operational role requiring strong knowledge of distribution operations, WMS functionality, order fulfillment processes, capacity constraints, and production planning. jobs.location_raw: Beverly Hills LAND, Beverly Hills, CA (HQ-L)
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW The Program Manager, International Payroll Implementation leads the end-to-end coordination of payroll-impacting activities for new country launches, payroll implementations, and related global transformation initiatives. This role ensures that required inputs, decisions, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables across Legal, HR, Benefits, Finance, IT, Payroll, local business stakeholders, and external vendors are identified, sequenced, tracked, and delivered in time to support a successful payroll go-live. The role is accountable for the integrated implementation plan, governance, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and overall payroll readiness across each rollout. While the Program Manager must bring a strong understanding of payroll and the upstream and downstream processes that affect it, this role does not own functional payroll configuration, complete provider implementation workbooks, or process payroll. Those activities are led by the Payroll team and relevant implementation partners; this role ensures the work is connected, on track, and ready for each key implementation milestone and go-live. As Customer Success Manager , you will serve as the primary point of contact and advisory partner for our customers: visiting and consulting with those customers in the field, and driving solutions across various groups within Formic for optimal delivery of technical, operational, training and administrative support for our industrial robot systems. You will play a key role in driving mutually beneficial customer relationships post-deployment by monitoring customer health and engagement, mitigating potential relationship and experience risks, and identifying growth opportunities in existing accounts. You will build and maintain strong customer relationships; develop a deep understanding of their business goals, challenges, and needs; and will leverage that feedback to provide customized insights and value-added products and services. This position is highly strategic and impactful in Formic’s mission to be a valued partner and leader driving the adoption of automation across the manufacturing industry. jobs.title: Head of Marketing - Bolingbrook, IL
jobs.description_text: About the team: Formic's Marketing Team is the growth engine behind our commercial expansion. We move fast, experiment boldly, and build systems that scale. We work in close lockstep with Sales, RevOps, and Leadership to generate pipeline, sharpen our message, and get in front of the right manufacturers at the right time. This team is small, high-impact, and driven - and we're looking for someone who can match that energy. About this role: As our Head of Marketing, you will build, optimize, and lead a scalable engine for creating demand and qualified pipeline. You will own how Formic shows up in the market, how we identify and reach the manufacturers we can help, and how we turn that engagement into high quality opportunities for Sales. This is a broad, hands-on role spanning Marketing, lead generation, Sales Development, and GTM Engineering and managing a team to deliver across those areas. You'll bring those capabilities together around a common goal: creating qualified pipeline and quantifying through data and insights what's driving it. As Formic grows, you'll help determine how the team and these capabilities evolve. We're looking for someone who combines creativity with operating rigor. You'll set strategy, but you'll stay close enough to the work to understand what's actually happening. You'll establish clear priorities, ownership, and metrics, and make decisions based on results. When something works, you'll scale it. When it doesn't, you'll change it or stop doing it

jobs.title: IT & Workplace Operations Lead
jobs.description_text: About the Role This is a hands-on role with a broad mandate. You’ll own the day-to-day technology experience for Formicans: computers, accounts, applications, permissions, onboarding and offboarding, endpoint management, IT support, office technology, and our relationship with our outside IT partner. You'll also help own the day-to-day experience of our Bolingbrook office and warehouse, making sure the space is organized, stocked, functional, and a great place to work. If the Wi-Fi is down, someone's badge doesn't work, a conference room isn't connecting, the TV needs to be ready for All Hands, a new hire needs a laptop, or the office is running low on something, you're the person who makes sure it gets handled. You aren't expected to personally pull every cable, install every camera, or perform every repair. You are expected to own the outcome. You don't need to know every system we use on Day 1. We'd rather hire someone with strong technical fundamentals, exceptional resourcefulness, and an ability to learn quickly. Over time, we expect you to become an expert in Formic's technology environment. You do need to be highly capable at using AI to extend what you can do. We want someone who is genuinely excited about technology and constantly asks: Why are we doing this manually? Can I automate it? Can I make this better? jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the team: The Project Engineering Team is a multidisciplinary engineering group within Automation Engineering Group, bringing mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering together under a single organization. The team serves as the engineering escalation path for the deployed fleet, taking on problems that exceed field-level troubleshooting and converting them into scoped, engineered, and standardized solutions. The team's work spans three connected areas. The first is the troubleshooting of complex problems: diagnosing multi-discipline failures across deployed robotic systems and engineering permanent, root-cause fixes rather than repeat repairs. The second is continuous improvement: converting recurring issues and field data into reliability upgrades and fleet-wide standardization. The third is support for existing and new product development and enhancements, in partnership with teams across the organization, to improve equipment currently in the field and to bring new capability online. Positioned at the intersection of design, commissioning, and field support, the team operates as a cross-functional unit, with engineers at the Bolingbrook hub working alongside field implementation resources across North America. The work is a deliberate blend of reactive support and proactive engineering, and each role on the team contributes to uptime, performance consistency, and long-term customer outcomes across the fleet. jobs.description_text: Figma employees are among the most AI-active in the industry, and our Internal AI team, part of FTS (our Business Technology org), helps turn that energy into meaningful impact by making it easier for every Figmate, from Sales and Support to Finance, People, and Legal, to safely adopt AI and use it to improve how they work. As common patterns emerge, you’ll partner with our Platform & Tooling and Infrastructure teams to build reusable capabilities that make future AI builds faster and safer. jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Brand Designer to join the Figma Brand Studio and focus on designing for the web. You’ll play a central role in defining how Figma shows up on the web through experiences that are inventive, accessible, and beautifully crafted. This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
